label: interiors
name: Interiors Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR interior image into one or more detailed categories based on the room type, visible furnishings, spatial function, and indoor environment.

labels.living_room: An image primarily showing a living room, lounge, or sitting area with sofas, chairs, tables, or home decor.
labels.bedroom: An image primarily showing a bedroom with a bed, bedside furniture, wardrobes, or sleeping-area decor.
labels.kitchen: An image primarily showing a kitchen with cabinets, counters, cooking appliances, or food preparation areas.
labels.bathroom: An image primarily showing a bathroom with a toilet, sink, shower, bathtub, or wash area.
labels.dining_room: An image primarily showing a dining room or dining area with a table and seating.
labels.office: An image primarily showing an office workspace with desks, chairs, computers, meeting tables, or work equipment.
labels.classroom: An image primarily showing a classroom, lecture room, or training room with desks, chairs, or teaching equipment.
labels.restaurant: An image primarily showing the interior of a restaurant, cafe, bar, or dining establishment.
labels.shop: An image primarily showing the inside of a shop, store, showroom, supermarket, or retail space.
labels.hotel_room: An image primarily showing a hotel bedroom, suite, or guest accommodation.
labels.lobby: An image primarily showing a lobby, reception area, waiting area, or entrance hall inside a building.
labels.hallway: An image primarily showing an indoor hallway, corridor, passage, or connecting space.
labels.hospital_room: An image primarily showing a hospital room, clinic room, treatment room, or medical interior.
labels.gym: An image primarily showing an indoor gym, fitness center, exercise room, or workout space.
labels.warehouse: An image primarily showing the inside of a warehouse, storage facility, or industrial storage area.
